scope: ProfRunTasks task structure and first-active-task routing

task_fixture: Chain lengths 0..16 in sixteen permutations; unchanged links, terminate-next and skip-next mutations during callback; normal/wrapping elapsed counter. limitations: Surrogate task layout with mocked first-task/timer APIs, not actual task allocation or full linked execution. Interrupted profile statistics, malformed task chains, DestroyTask internals and GBA timing remain unverified.
